name: Breastfeeding
overview: Scripture presents breastfeeding as a natural and God-ordained means of nurturing and sustaining life, as seen in the early care of Isaac and the intimate bond formed through nursing (Genesis 21:7-8; Ruth 4:16). It also symbolizes God's provision and blessing, described as 'blessings of the breasts and of the womb' (Genesis 49:25), and reflects the tender dependence of human life on divine care from the womb onward (Psalms 22:9). The references to breasts and nursing underscore both physical sustenance and the nurturing relationship foundational to human existence as designed by God.
